brief: @buildthis.bisks.net 2D side-scrolling Sisyphus simulator game, playable in the browser. Along with pushing the rock, Sisyphus needs to avoid obstacles and enemies impeding his progress. Include appropriate parallax scenery in the background.
note: sisyphus is live: push the boulder up the mountain, leap the chasms and scree, duck the crows. get hit and the boulder rolls back down the slope — undoing your climb, forever. six palettes, live-synth audio.
